source_fidelity.0: Fabricated or wrong-scope source or unsupported central claim
source_fidelity.1: Major claims lack or misuse evidence
source_fidelity.2: Some claims traceable; material gaps remain
source_fidelity.3: All material claims traceable with minor noncritical omissions
source_fidelity.4: All claims source-entailing and scoped; observations, inference and user assertions distinguished

numeric_correctness.2: Mostly correct with unresolved precision/window gaps
numeric_correctness.4: Independently verified values, units, precision, dates, windows and locators; missing data explicit

asset_time_correctness.0: Wrong asset/case or future evidence used
asset_time_correctness.2: Partial scope, ambiguous linkage not fully handled
asset_time_correctness.3: Correct scope with minor trace omission
asset_time_correctness.4: All asset/case/time/availability links verified; ambiguity explicitly resolved or clarified

mechanism_completeness.1: Incomplete causal pathway or incompatible mechanism
mechanism_completeness.3: Coherent tentative pathway with specific limits
mechanism_completeness.4: Coherent evidence-bounded alternatives, meaningful assumptions and discriminating checks

contradictions_unknowns.4: Both sides sourced, unknown distinguished from false, no unjustified resolution

diagnostic_usefulness.3: Relevant bounded next checks tied to uncertainty
diagnostic_usefulness.4: Prioritized discriminating evidence collection; appropriate professional boundary and no equipment commands

clarity.3: Simple answer then useful technical detail
clarity.4: Concise plain explanation preserves technical meaning, audience and uncertainty

latency_brevity.0: Timeout/no usable answer or severe verbosity
latency_brevity.1: Material measured slowdown or excessive prefacing
latency_brevity.2: Usable with redundant text or some measured regression
latency_brevity.3: Useful text promptly; no material regression under predefined paired budget
latency_brevity.4: Best concise informative answer within predeclared paired latency budget; no loss of critical detail

not_applicable: Omit dimension only if specified in independently reviewed case key before scoring; document reason. Never replace unmeasured latency with 4.
review: Two blinded reviewers; retain separate scores and disagreement; adjudicate without overwriting original annotations.
critical_gate: Any critical factual error fails that case independently of ordinal mean.
latency: Capture actual first nonempty answer delta and full response. Agree material-regression budget before trial; no estimated latency or generic accuracy score.
